title: return
existing: bulk-approve, countersign, bulk-reject, reopen and bulk-reassign
requirements: 本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve，金额超过 50000 的采购单进入 pending-second，等待另一位审批人会签）、会签（POST /purchases/{id}/countersign）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增退回：第二位审批人可以把一张等待会签的采购单退回给申请人补充材料。接口为 POST /purchases/{id}/return，请求体严格为 {"reason":"..."}，reason 为 1..200 字节，说明退回原因。只有已认证的 approver 可以调用。目标必须是当前租户中他人创建、状态为 pending-second 的采购单；把这张采购单批到 pending-second 的那位审批人不能退回它，只有另一位审批人可以。成功后该采购单 status 变为 returned，其他列都不变。找不到目标、目标属于其他租户、由调用者本人创建、状态不是 pending-second、或调用者正是批到 pending-second 的那位审批人时，返回 4xx，数据库全部不变。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Item 完成（verb 为 return，role 为 approver），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"id":ID,"status":"returned"}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一目标时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同目标返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与退回在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "return.v8"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 同时退回同一采购单时恰好一个返回 200、另一个返回 4xx，只退回一次。退回后的采购单不能再被会签、批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交或改派（4xx，数据库不变）。requester 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、会签、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。

implicit-audit.rule: Every return writes exactly one ApprovalAudit row in the same transaction: tenantId, purchaseId, approvedBy=actor, operation=return.v8, idempotencyKey=key, fromStatus=pending-second, toStatus=returned, reason=request reason; an audit write failure rolls everything back.

manual: Drift returns every Purchase whose status is not the toStatus
drafted: transition needs From != To, no column, and ApprovalAudit
Drift returns every Purchase whose status is not the toStatus

implicit-request-hash.rule: ActionRequest.requestHash equals ledger.Fingerprint("return.v8", [id]); the reason is not digested, so the same key and target with another reason replays.

manual: is not part of the digest
drafted: must be a distinct non-reason input
is not part of the digest

implicit-outbox.rule: Every return writes exactly one PurchaseEvent row in the same transaction: type=purchase.returned, purchaseId, actorId=actor, idempotencyKey=key; an outbox write failure rolls everything back.

implicit-uniform-denial.rule: Missing, other-tenant, own, not-pending-second targets and the first approver all get the same 4xx status, so a response never reveals whether or why a purchase is ineligible.
